scope: Pre-promotion diagnosis of the v11-c1-gate-check failure 'function not in directory: poke'. No product implementation or product profile was changed by this fix.

initial_failure.reproduction: All 190 other resolved source-baseline cases pass individually; only the newly added Wave-1 banner case fails when executed in the historical profile.

product_path.cross_parity_result: passed; missing and unclassified sets are empty
product_path.conclusion: poke is correctly implemented and wired in the product profile; there is no product-directory regression.

second_live_baseline_drift.finding: After excluding only the banner case, the mutable source baseline fails later because the source M65D suite already binds the generated dialect-v2 resident suite. IDE baseline composition then includes both historical and generated resident definitions and reports duplicate code object not.
second_live_baseline_drift.lesson: A live source tree is not a stable historical observation baseline. Pruning one new case would repair the symptom but leave the baseline class mutable.

structural_fix.policy: Consume the SHA-bound, post-filter observation receipt as the immutable baseline and enumerate the banner as the sole intentional addition. Live source-suite paths remain provenance only and are not re-executed as historical state.
structural_fix.result: passed: four artifacts, 357 cases, zero observation differences; banner is the one explicit addition

claim_limit: This diagnosis proves that the reported poke failure came from executing new dialect-v2 banner code inside a mutable historical baseline and that the current product profile supplies poke in all declared views. It does not promote product bytes, authorize C1 capacity, prove hardware behavior, or claim G5/G6 acceptance.
